notes.title: Endgame Major Update
notes.notes: [p]This major update includes changes, optimizations, bug fixes and massive update to the endgame content. The following is a summary of the update's contents, without giving away spoilers.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Massive change to how the end-game gameplay works including new objectives, resources, functionality, game modes and challenges. These are spoilers, so no details will be provided.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new Steam achievements to unlock[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added dropdown setting for choosing framerate limit (applied when v-sync is not enabled)[/p][/*][*][p]Added shortcut for holding Ctrl + clicking (or equivalent for gamepad) to repair failed asset[/p][/*][*][p]Termite mission will better randomise which pole is chosen[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to volumes of some sounds, particularly if played in UI rather than normal gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization for the procedural generation code related to the environment/map[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization in star movement code[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization improved for loads switching between peak and off-peak current draw. Transition occurs for every load connected to a substation at the one time with substations timing staggered, rather than staggering every load individually.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization in path calculation when adding/removing new assets. Also a once-off popup tip that having many loops in a network slows performance which will popup if the user has a significant performance stutter.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted cost of research for solar, wind and batteries research. Solar now costs 1SP, wind costs 2SP and batteries costs 3SP plus $10K. Previously these three didn't cost science points (SP).[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations for when large numbers of Loads are connected[/p][/*][*][p]Rubble on placement, previously only used for roads and buildings is now shown for placement of all assets. Buildings also now rise out of the ground with more interesting animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new "Next" and "Previous" button to the EPR/GRP panel as an alternative to clicking the asset on the map (e.g. the next substation). This is important for gamepad users who won't have a mouse given the maps assets aren't UI buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix to camera movement where it would jump view slightly if you pressed Q or E (pan left or right) after having zoomed out or in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you could start a mission requiring solar panels before you had researched them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a star can get in the way of the preview of an asset (shown as a white box)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where synchronization of generators UI could show for generators on a secondary network (but wouldn't work as only one network is allowed).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the bottom UI bar in the Final Map Audit would not fill up (visually) when the full required amount was obtained. Text also now changes to green to clearly show map is complete.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to how maximum renewables penetration is calculated relative load sharing on the network[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when moving from an all renewables network to a network with power generators, where the generator would think it's on a secondary network.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to show localization not showing for certain UI panels (e.g. the 'Are You Sure You Want To ...' Restart, Quit, Naming the island etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse-over of an Energy Hub Substation while building conductors will now tell you how many free connection points are left.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to button navigation using gamepad on for some UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug that had potential to not show earthing visuals on Energy Hub Substation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where if user is using gamepad, then alt-tabs to another program or uses the Steam overlay, the mouse will be locked to the center screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations with how reliability and status of assets is calculated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'install angle relative to wind' value for conductors which was showing at 0. Used as part of conductor thermals calculation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization issues, such as for "On Strike!" button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed EPR/GPR UI glitch which would briefly play ambience sound after pressing save or changing assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the protection panel would not detect conductors on one side of a substation so could not give a recommended overcurrent protection setting. Also fixed the recommended overcurrent value choosing the highest current carrying capacity rather than the lowest.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor tweaks and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6r9WCNsR7q8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Linux Changes, Bug Fixes and Minor Tweaks
notes.notes:
This update features the following changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where on a loaded game, its possible to have two assets with the same name. This only causes issues when trying to adjust their earthing/grounding and is fixed if the player tries to rename the asset, as uniqueness is then checked, but is now checked by default.
[*] Linux users will now be using the Vulkan renderer by default, which will fallback to OpenGL Core if it fails (using the Unity automated graphics API). This order was previously reversed but should have better compatibility with newer cards.
[*] Game save files, progress and settings are now forced to store in "Power Network Tycoon_Data\SavesDir". This change should only affect some Linux users (who may have had issues with Steam Cloud saving). If your game settings or game saves have disappeared, move them from the old directory to the new one.
[*] Added toggle to disable "View Fault" when is when a fault occurs on the network and the camera jumps to look at it (also slowing down time briefly). This can get annoying with many faults occurring for some players, so toggle added in settings menu. Default is enabled.
[*] Tap/click sound changed from 50% volume to 30% for UI mouseover
[*] Other minor tweaks and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.notes:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Phase 1: Early Access Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Over the past few weeks since launching on early access, we've been working with players to address key areas to improve gameplay. Below are a few of the signficant changes since first release.
[list]
[*] Added ability to have multiple generators connected to the network, including both synchronization mechanic for added generators, generator loading sharing and a 'black start' when all generators fail
[*] Added more tutorials, including video tutorials to clarify gameplay mechancis
[*] Added new shortcut including holding Ctrl + clicking to place a pole while drawing conductors, change a load between substations and connect a capacitor bank
[*] Stats tracking between games/maps
[*] Improvements with gameplay, UI and performance
[/list]

Within this update itself, there are also changes to the following:
[list]
[*] Added subtitles to basic training tutorial video (more to come)
[*] Modified camera viewing angles to allow 20 degrees to 90 degrees when using a mouse
[*] Changed sparks and deaths associated with GPR/EPR to occur at same speed regardless of gameplay speed
[*] Added 'Building count limit' to settings menu, allowing players to limit the number of buildings in a city for better gameplay performance. Once at the limit, new load buildings placed are more likely to be higher wealth buildings (replacing one recently destroyed), allowing the city to still grow
[*] Upgraded skybox to be more detailed with morning, day, sunset and night materials
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]
[previewyoutube=WmWDX4xp6yk;full][/previewyoutube]
